llms-sitemap.description: Every public, AI-agent-readable surface on councilof.ai. Each entry includes the URL, the human + machine content, and a one-line description. This file is the answer-engine cousin of /sitemap.xml.

entry.description: Council of AI homepage — the entry point for independent AI governance measurement.
LIVE 22-axis GSPC board (GET returns JSON; cite `totals.public_count`, never a typed integer).
Free browser-side signed-card verifier — paste a card body or sha256, recompute the hash and Ed25519 signature, no server call.
Model Context Protocol door — POST /mcp with tools/call for board_totals, get_axis, get_root, get_card, verify_card, verify_inclusion, list_cards.
The AEO surface for AI agents — the canonical machine-readable description of the estate.
The upgrade changelog — every shipped surface, last 14 days. The single page to read to learn what we have and how to use it.
Get the GSPC badge on your HuggingFace model — the badge enroller docs, with two copy-paste badges and a 4-step README snippet.
The live catalog of every csoai/* HuggingFace Space (42 live), loaded from the HF API at page load.
The canonical 22-axis reference — each axis: scope, what's MEASURED, the discipline (TIE is TIE), the lane (where to look).
Products and SKUs. Verify is free forever. Three things invoice. Measurement, not certification.
The governance MCP fleet — 216 servers across 10 hives. The 4 public-side tools (MCP, Chrome ext, Grok plugin, Hermes skill) on the rail.
5 access surfaces — MCP, Chrome MV3 extension, Grok plugin, Hermes skill, REST + curl. The pluggable measurement rail.
The bench pack — frozen item banks, the GSPC grader, the canonical-form signing rule. Source code for the measurement rail.
What this methodology does and does not claim. Not a safety certification. We report measured refusals and survivals.
The CSOAI system card — what we measure, what we don't, the lid, the discipline.
Trust center — signed public-root, corrections ledger, witness receipts, Bitcoin OTS anchor.
Public corrections ledger (39 entries) — every change to the lid, the doctrine, the wheel. The mill measuring itself.
XRPL reader — 16 named issuers, n_measured=0. Never a grade. Reader facts only, writes_board=false.
SWIFT census — 26 named banks (3 LIVE · 9 COMMITTED · 14 DISCOVERED). Not clients, not MEASURED, sourced to a real press URL.
Post-quantum continuity honesty — Ed25519 CLASSICAL is the live signer; ML-DSA-65 is UNCHECKABLE until a real TEE is wired.
C2PA manifest verifier — Article 50 evidence pack. Verifies a C2PA manifest, returns the three-state verdict.
Detector interop endpoint — crosswalk of GSPC axes to external detectors (jailbreak, prompt-injection, OWASP LLM Top 10, etc.).
in-toto attestation verifier — Article 50 evidence pack. Returns a three-state verdict (VALID / INVALID+reason / UNCHECKABLE).
For regulators — what we measure, the corrections ledger pattern, the per-axis methodology.
For insurers — signed evidence per RWA issuer (XRPL-16), SWIFT census, the corrections ledger as a public witness.
For government — the same free public rail. No login, no CAC, no money from anything ranked.
For enterprise — the paid SKUs (issue, proofs, embedded rails). Verify is free forever.
The signed public-root — 50 cards, merkle, Ed25519-signed under did:web:csoai.org#card-attestation-1. Witnessed on Rekor + Bitcoin OTS.
The canonical verification rule. Read this before signing anything that says CSOAI.
The governance axis page — n=237, what the model is graded on, the canonical 30-item bank.
The jail axis page — n=71, the containment floor, TIE attestation, the static-scan detector bank.
The A2A agent card — 4 skills (gspc-verify, get_axis, board_totals, list_cards). Discoverable by any A2A-conformant agent.
Server-side cached mirror of every csoai/* HuggingFace Space (42), Dataset (60+), and Model (3). 5 min cache.
The XML sitemap (482 URLs) for classical search engines.
robots.txt — every AI crawler handled exactly once. ai-input=yes (grounding allowed), ai-train=no (training reserved).
